uv-printing.description: Experience high-precision UV flatbed printing that bonds liquid ink instantly to acrylic, wood, glass, leather, and composite boards. Micro-calibrated, scratch-proof, and engineered for perfection.

infoCard1.title: Micron Precision
infoCard1.desc: Calibrated accuracy down to 0.05mm across multi-pass runs.

infoCard2.title: Instant Curing
infoCard2.desc: UV LED lamps dry liquid ink immediately for instant handling.

bentoItems.title: Bespoke Materials
bentoItems.desc: From leather to composite polymers, our adhesion primers handle complex substrates.

benefits.title: Instant UV Curing
benefits.desc: Inks dry instantly under UV LED lamps, allowing immediate handling and fabrication without smudging.

benefits.title: Vibrant Color
benefits.desc: Rich layer density with high-opacity white ink for vibrant prints on dark and transparent materials.

benefits.title: Durable Finish
benefits.desc: Scratch, water, chemical, and fade resistant. UV cured inks are engineered for long-term industrial use.

benefits.title: Direct Printing
benefits.desc: Skip stickers and vinyl labels. We print directly onto finished items for a seamless, executive aesthetic.

workflowSteps.title: Design Optimization
workflowSteps.desc: We review vector artwork (AI, CDR, PDF, DXF) to calibrate white ink layers and primer paths for pixel-perfect output.

workflowSteps.title: Physical Proofing
workflowSteps.desc: Receive digital mockups or physical sample test prints to verify color accuracy, scale, and surface adhesion quality.

workflowSteps.title: Flatbed Production
workflowSteps.desc: Our industrial UV flatbed printers execute the run with multi-pass precision, instant LED curing, and quality control.

trustPoints.title: Integrated Fabrication
trustPoints.desc: Sourcing, laser cutting, and UV printing under one facility in Saravanampatti for total quality accountability.

trustPoints.title: Extreme Machine Tolerance
trustPoints.desc: Weekly printhead laser calibration keeps our alignment tolerance within 0.05mm across multi-layer runs.

faqs.q: What is the maximum object size you can print?
faqs.a: Our industrial UV flatbed printers handle rigid media up to 2.5m x 1.3m (98" x 51") with a height clearance of 150mm for 3D objects and thick substrates.

faqs.q: How long does UV printing last outdoors?
faqs.a: Our UV LED-cured inks are weather and fade resistant. Standard outdoor lifespan is 3 to 5 years without fading, extensible with optional clear varnish top-coats.

faqs.q: Can you print white ink on dark or transparent objects?
faqs.a: Yes! We utilize high-opacity white ink channels to lay down a dense base layer on dark, coated, or clear materials, ensuring vibrant full-color accuracy.

faqs.q: What artwork formats do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept vector files including CorelDraw (.CDR), Adobe Illustrator (.AI), PDF, EPS, and high-res raster files (PNG, TIFF) formatted at 300 DPI.

laser-cutting.description: High-precision CO2 laser cutting for acrylic, wood, MDF, and technical polymers. Zero-distortion beam slicing engineered with 0.1mm tolerance for a flawless part fit.

infoCard1.title: Flame-Polished Finish
infoCard1.desc: Acrylic parts leave the bed glass-clear with zero secondary buffing.

infoCard2.title: Zero Edge Distortion
infoCard2.desc: Non-contact cutting prevents part warping or material stress fractures.

bentoItems.title: Complex Geometries
bentoItems.desc: Interlocking 3D puzzles, gear arrays, and filigree lattice panels cut seamlessly.

benefits.title: 0.1mm Beam Accuracy
benefits.desc: Holds razor-thin tolerances suitable for press-fit enclosures and precision mechanical gear teeth.

benefits.title: Zero Tool Wear
benefits.desc: Because the laser beam never touches the stock, part #1000 is as sharp and exact as part #1.

benefits.title: Sheet Nesting Optimization
benefits.desc: Algorithmic nesting reduces material scrap by up to 35% on large corporate production runs.

benefits.title: Flame-Polished Edges
benefits.desc: Clear acrylic comes off the bed with crystal smooth edges ready for immediate use.

workflowSteps.title: CAD Vector Verification
workflowSteps.desc: We verify DXF, DWG, AI, and CDR vectors for kerf offset and closed outline integrity.

workflowSteps.title: Optics Focus & Nesting
workflowSteps.desc: Materials are calibrated to focal depth and nested for maximum yield across the sheet.

workflowSteps.title: High-Speed Slicing
workflowSteps.desc: CO2 laser optics execute cuts at high speed with automatic exhaust fume extraction.

trustPoints.title: Calibrated Beam Alignment
trustPoints.desc: Our optical mirrors undergo daily alignment checks to prevent kerf taper on thick cast acrylic.

trustPoints.title: Clean Material Sourcing
trustPoints.desc: We use high-grade virgin cast acrylic that doesn’t yellow, chip, or smell during cutting.

faqs.q: What is the maximum thickness of acrylic you can laser cut?
faqs.a: We can cut clear and colored cast acrylic up to 12mm thick with clean, flame-polished edges.

faqs.q: What materials can you laser cut and engrave?
faqs.a: Our CO2 lasers are optimized for non-metallic substrates — cast acrylic, solid wood, MDF, leather, paper, and glass — cutting and etching each with clean, polished edges.

faqs.q: What vector file formats do you accept for cutting?
faqs.a: We accept DXF, DWG, AI, CDR, and PDF files. Please ensure text is converted to outlines/curves.

faqs.q: Do laser-cut acrylic edges need polishing after cutting?
faqs.a: No! Cast acrylic edges cut by our CO2 laser come off the machine bed glass-clear with zero flame-polishing required.

laser-engraving.description: High-resolution laser marking and etching that permanently burns intricate logos, serial numbers, and designs onto solid timber, cast acrylic, leather, and glass.

infoCard1.title: Indelible Markings
infoCard1.desc: Laser etched graphics will never peel, fade, or rub off over decades.

infoCard2.title: Micro Detail Printing
infoCard2.desc: Engrave intricate QR codes, barcodes, and sub-millimeter serial numbers.

bentoItems.title: Machine Panels & Tags
bentoItems.desc: High-contrast etched control panels and tags with crisp black-on-light or white-on-dark legends.

benefits.title: Permanent Substrate Bond
benefits.desc: Engraving physically alters the surface layer so text cannot be removed with solvents or friction.

benefits.title: 1200 DPI Micro Detail
benefits.desc: Engrave micro-fine vector lines, photographic half-tones, and complex corporate logos.

benefits.title: 3D Tactile Relief
benefits.desc: Depth control allows light surface marks or deep 3D relief engraving in timber and acrylic.

benefits.title: Serial & Barcode Marking
benefits.desc: Automated sequential serial number etching for industrial equipment compliance.

workflowSteps.title: Grayscale Calibration
workflowSteps.desc: Design graphics are converted to high-contrast rasters or vector etch paths.

workflowSteps.title: Focal Depth Setting
workflowSteps.desc: The laser head is calibrated to match the exact surface curvature of the target part.

workflowSteps.title: Micro Beam Pass
workflowSteps.desc: High-frequency pulse passes burn or mark the target substrate permanently.

trustPoints.title: Sub-Millimeter Alignment
trustPoints.desc: Laser alignment fixtures guarantee logo centering on curved tumblers, pens, and nameplates.

trustPoints.title: High-Contrast Output
trustPoints.desc: We optimize laser power and speed settings for deep, rich dark contrast without char smudging.

faqs.q: Will laser engraving rub off over time?
faqs.a: No! Laser engraving physically removes or vaporizes material, creating a permanent mark that will not scratch, peel, or fade.

faqs.q: Can you engrave custom logos and signatures?
faqs.a: Yes! We can engrave vector logos, custom typography, handwritten signatures, and high-contrast photographs.

faqs.q: Can you engrave on cylindrical objects like tumblers or bottles?
faqs.a: Yes, we use a rotary attachment that rotates cylindrical items during engraving for 360-degree wrapped designs.

3d-printing.description: Turn digital 3D models into functional physical prototypes, complex jigs, and end-use production components using industrial FDM and SLA resin 3D printers.

infoCard1.title: Rapid Turnaround
infoCard1.desc: Go from 3D CAD file to physical prototype in under 24 hours.

infoCard2.title: High Layer Resolution
infoCard2.desc: Precision SLA resin prints with glass-smooth surface finishes.

bentoItems.title: Prototyping & Short Runs
bentoItems.desc: Iterate product designs rapidly without expensive injection mold tooling.

benefits.title: Zero Tooling Investment
benefits.desc: Print complex organic geometry directly from STL files without requiring expensive molds or dies.

benefits.title: 0.08mm Layer Resolution
benefits.desc: Ultra-fine SLA resin printing delivers smooth surfaces suitable for investment casting or master molds.

benefits.title: Functional Infill Tuning
benefits.desc: Control internal density from 15% lightweight infill up to 100% solid structural parts.

benefits.title: Multi-Material Library
benefits.desc: Choose from PLA+, Tough ABS, PETG, Nylon, TPU flexible rubber, and high-temp resins.

workflowSteps.title: STL File Slicing
workflowSteps.desc: 3D CAD files (STL, OBJ, STEP) are sliced into layer G-code paths with optimized support structures.

workflowSteps.title: Additive Bed Run
workflowSteps.desc: Industrial FDM/SLA printers deposit material with micro-extrusion precision.

workflowSteps.title: Post-Curing & Cleanup
workflowSteps.desc: Supports are removed, parts UV cured (SLA), sanded, and inspected against 3D CAD dimensions.

trustPoints.title: Dimensional Accuracy
trustPoints.desc: Calibrated stepper motors and enclosed print chambers prevent thermal warping across large prints.

trustPoints.title: Full Post-Processing
trustPoints.desc: We offer support removal, vapor smoothing, surface priming, and UV printing on finished 3D parts.

faqs.q: What 3D file formats do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, and 3MF files.

faqs.q: What is the difference between FDM and SLA 3D printing?
faqs.a: FDM extrudes thermoplastic filaments layer-by-layer (great for strong functional parts), while SLA uses a laser to cure liquid resin (delivering smooth surface details).

faqs.q: How fast can I get a 3D prototype printed?
faqs.a: Most standard prototype prints are completed and ready for pickup or dispatch within 24 to 48 hours.

custom-gifts.description: Create memorable corporate gifts, personalized wooden keepsakes, photo acrylic awards, and custom branded merchandise using combined laser cutting, engraving, and UV printing.

infoCard1.title: Executive Finish
infoCard1.desc: Hand-assembled personalized keepsakes packaged in luxury gift boxes.

infoCard2.title: Single Piece Custom
infoCard2.desc: No minimum order quantities — order 1 custom gift or 1,000 corporate items.

bentoItems.title: Corporate Onboarding Kits
bentoItems.desc: Customized gift boxes with laser cut inserts, printed notebooks, and branded accessories.

benefits.title: Multi-Technology Hybrid
benefits.desc: Combine laser cutting, precision engraving, and vibrant UV printing on a single custom item.

benefits.title: No Minimum Order Limits
benefits.desc: Whether you need a single anniversary trophy or 500 corporate employee gifts, we handle both with equal care.

benefits.title: Executive Packaging
benefits.desc: Optional custom laser-cut foam inserts and velvet-lined luxury gift boxes.

benefits.title: Free Digital Proofs
benefits.desc: Receive realistic 3D visual proofs to approve layout, font, and placement before production begins.

workflowSteps.title: Concept & Digital Mockup
workflowSteps.desc: Choose your gift base and send your text, logo, or photo for visual layout proofing.

workflowSteps.title: Precision Fabrication
workflowSteps.desc: Our studio laser engraves, cuts, and UV prints your design onto the selected substrate.

workflowSteps.title: Hand Polish & Packaging
workflowSteps.desc: Items are inspected, hand-cleaned, and packed securely for immediate gifting.

trustPoints.title: In-House Studio Production
trustPoints.desc: We fabricate gifts directly in Saravanampatti without middlemen, keeping prices fair and lead times fast.

trustPoints.title: Uncompromised Quality Control
trustPoints.desc: Every item undergoes individual surface inspection before boxing.

faqs.q: Can I order just 1 custom item?
faqs.a: Yes! We specialized in single-piece custom orders as well as large corporate bulk runs.

faqs.q: Can you engrave or print our company logo?
faqs.a: Yes, send your logo in high-res PNG, vector AI, CDR, or PDF format, and we will format it for optimal output.

faqs.q: Do you offer gift boxes and packaging?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide optional luxury gift boxes with custom laser-cut foam inserts.

sign-boards.description: High-impact storefront signage, 3D acrylic backlit letters, built-up acrylic logo boards, and architectural retail displays engineered to elevate brand presence.

infoCard1.title: IP65 Weatherproof
infoCard1.desc: Sealed outdoor LEDs and non-rusting acrylic and composite panels for 5+ years of durability.

infoCard2.title: 3D Halo & Front Illumination
infoCard2.desc: Uniform LED diffusion creates stunning nighttime storefront visibility.

bentoItems.title: Retail Display Stands
bentoItems.desc: Custom illuminated display kiosks engineered for malls and flagship retail stores.

benefits.title: Uniform LED Diffusion
benefits.desc: High-lumen Samsung/Osram LED modules ensure zero hot-spots or dark patches in 3D letters.

benefits.title: All-Weather Construction
benefits.desc: Marine-grade ACP, weatherproof PVC foam, and UV-stabilized cast acrylic.

benefits.title: Complete On-Site Fit-Out
benefits.desc: Our field crew handles mounting, structural framing, and electrical power connections.

benefits.title: Energy Efficient (12V DC)
benefits.desc: Low-power 12V LED drivers reduce operating electricity costs by up to 60%.

workflowSteps.title: Site Measurement & Render
workflowSteps.desc: We inspect storefront dimensions and provide daytime & nighttime 3D visual renders.

workflowSteps.title: Laser Cutting & LED Fit
workflowSteps.desc: 3D letters are laser cut, acrylic returns bonded, and waterproof LED modules wired.

workflowSteps.title: On-Site Mounting & Testing
workflowSteps.desc: Our installation team mounts the board, connects power drivers, and verifies illumination.

trustPoints.title: Turnkey Installation
trustPoints.desc: From initial site surveying to high-altitude mounting and electrical wiring, we handle everything.

trustPoints.title: Warranty Guarantee
trustPoints.desc: All outdoor LED sign boards come with a 2-year warranty on LED modules and power supplies.

faqs.q: Do you provide site measurement and installation in Coimbatore?
faqs.a: Yes! Our site survey and installation teams handle measurement, structural mounting, and power hookups across Coimbatore and Tamil Nadu.

faqs.q: What types of illumination do you offer for 3D letters?
faqs.a: We offer front-lit (face illuminated), halo-lit (backlit glow), edge-lit acrylic, and non-illuminated matte acrylic finishes.

faqs.q: How long does a 3D LED sign board take to fabricate?
faqs.a: Standard 3D LED storefront signage takes 5 to 7 working days from design approval to on-site installation.
